question:
Which word is closest in meaning to grim?

The visitor sat with a look of grim resolution on his face.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Serious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"grim"** refers to something stern, serious, or forbidding in appearance or demeanor. It is often associated with a sense of severity or harshness. (गंभीर/कठोर)
 
 
• **Example:** The soldier's grim expression revealed the gravity of the situation.
 
 
• **"Serious"** is the closest word in meaning to "grim" as it also conveys a sense of being solemn or grave. (गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example:** His serious tone made everyone pay attention to the issue at hand.
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'Serious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Serious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Relaxed **(आरामदायक): Free from tension or anxiety; calm and easy-going.
 
 
• **Example:** After finishing the project, she felt relaxed and happy.
 
 
 
• **Joyful** (आनंदमय): Feeling, expressing, or causing great happiness or delight.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were joyful during the birthday celebration.
 
 
 
• **Content** (संतुष्ट): A state of being satisfied or at peace with one's situation.
 
 
• **Example:** He was content with his life and had no complaints.
